title: Robotics: Capture a Free-Floating Cargo Module

steps.hint: Select the CHECKLIST tab on the camera display on your right. Capture is always flown from the checklist.
ARM POWER is the far-left toggle on the ARM CONTROL panel ahead of you. The arm cannot move without power.
CAMERA 2 is on the camera display on your right. It is the view that shows the cargo module grapple fixture.
Turn the SHOULDER dial on the ARM CONTROL panel to TARGET. Large joints move first, then the small ones.
WRIST is the dial to the right of SHOULDER. The wrist lines the end effector up with the grapple fixture.
CAPTURE is the left lever on the panel on your left. RELEASE is next to it; do not confuse the two.
BRAKES ON is bottom-left on the ARM CONTROL panel. Brakes hold the arm still after capture.
REPORT is bottom-right on the ARM CONTROL panel. It tells mission control the module is captured and braked.
